entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CopyLocalLockFileAssemblies causes MSB3030 when dependency contains culture-specific resources #50462
  • `dotnet new global.json --sdk-version` incorrectly accepts invalid SDK versions like `9.0.x`, emit error instead #50460

Closed

  • dotnet cannot install on Debian Trixie from official MS packages because libicu76 is too new #48973
  • `dotnet completions script pwsh` is very different from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/tools/enable-tab-autocomplete#powershell #50387
  • first-run experience can impact the completions command in a way that breaks the command #50444
  • In net10 preview7, nunit test fail in MTP mode in command Line 'dotnet test' but success in vs2022 when using 'dotnet.config'. #50456
  • adding to CreateSatelliteAssembliesDependsOn broken for Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WindowsDesktop? #3186
    Discussion
  • dotnet ef throws exception System.ArgumentException: Illegal characters in path. #7693
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Make CA1860 work with abstract collections #50461
    Area-Infrastructure

Updated

  • Spike of generated COM interop and LibraryImports #49669
    Area-CLI
  • Move generating implicit framework defines to a target. #45696
    Area-NetSDK
  • Fix first-run experience output interfering with completion commands #50454
  • Add GitHub Actions workflow for updating static web assets baselines #49730
